svg.aria-label: Animated comparison of FIFO and textbook CLOCK on the access trace A B E A B with four slots. FIFO zaps recently used page A to load E, then refaults A and B, for 3 faults. CLOCK clears the referenced bits of A and B, zaps C instead, and finishes with 1 fault.

g.text: Same trace, 4 slots: FIFO vs textbook CLOCK
A's bit is 1: clear it, skip
B's bit is 1: clear it, skip
Both caches start with the same pages, all unreferenced.
FIFO evicts by age, so the page just used goes first.
A was used since the hand last passed: second chance.
C is the first page nobody used.
FIFO pays for throwing out A.
Checking recent use kept the hot pages; FIFO threw them out by age.
